details.availability: Public TypeScript source with AppImage, Snap and npm releases; some agent features are behind a paid Premium subscription, and the built-in assistant needs a user-supplied model provider.

name: Vessel Browser
notes: Published under the Quanta Intellect name (repository homepage). Built on Electron 40 with SolidJS; Linux AppImage, Snap and npm installs are offered, and the README calls Linux the most mature target, with macOS packaging from source. The MCP server (default port 3100, bearer token in ~/.config/vessel/mcp-auth.json, vessel-browser-mcp --stdio proxy) is meant for harnesses such as Hermes Agent, OpenClaw or Codex; its interaction tools click, type and select by the element index from the page-content listing, with CSS selector or visible-text fallbacks. Page extraction numbers interactive elements and infers a page schema (page type, form fields, action buttons). The built-in sidebar assistant uses the same tools with Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama, llama.cpp or other OpenAI-compatible providers. Supervisor controls cover approvals per action, run or domain, pausing, checkpoints, named sessions and undo of the last mutating action. Skills, screenshot analysis, the credential vault, Obsidian memory and parts of the Research Desk require a paid Premium subscription. Root LICENSE is MIT.
summary: Electron/Chromium browser built as a visible runtime for agents: a local MCP server and a built-in assistant read pages as indexed elements and click, type and navigate, with scoped approvals, checkpoints and undo.
